title: Jolt Physics - immediate `body_get_direct_state` call on KinematicBodies gets outdated position
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.4.1-stable, Godot 4.5-beta5

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7680) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads)

### Issue description

When setting position of a KinematicBody with `body_set_state`, immediately querying transform retrieves an outdated position state. This does not occur for RigidBodies nor StaticBodies. Furthermore, this does not occur when using KinematicBodies with the original GodotPhysics3D engine nor third-party physics engines such as RapierPhysics3D.

### Steps to reproduce

```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	# Settting up the physics server
	print("Physics engine: ", ProjectSettings.get_setting("physics/3d/physics_engine"))
	
	var physics_space:RID = PhysicsServer3D.space_create()
	PhysicsServer3D.space_set_active(physics_space, true)

	var transform: Transform3D = Transform3D()
	transform.origin = Vector3(100, 100, 100)
	print("Attempting to instantiate and position bodies to ", transform.origin)

	# static gets immediate position update
	print("Positioning static bodies")
	var body_rid_static: RID = PhysicsServer3D.body_create()
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_space(body_rid_static, physics_space)
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_mode(body_rid_static, PhysicsServer3D.BODY_MODE_STATIC)
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_state(body_rid_static, PhysicsServer3D.BODY_STATE_TRANSFORM, transform)
	print("Queried transform is ", PhysicsServer3D.body_get_direct_state(body_rid_static).get_transform().origin)
	assert (PhysicsServer3D.body_get_direct_state(body_rid_static).get_transform().origin == Vector3(100, 100, 100))

	# rigid also gets immediate position update
	print("Positioning rigid bodies")
	var body_rid_rigid: RID = PhysicsServer3D.body_create()
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_space(body_rid_rigid, physics_space)
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_mode(body_rid_rigid, PhysicsServer3D.BODY_MODE_RIGID)

	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_state(body_rid_rigid, PhysicsServer3D.BODY_STATE_TRANSFORM, transform)
	print("Queried transform is ", PhysicsServer3D.body_get_direct_state(body_rid_rigid).get_transform().origin)
	assert (PhysicsServer3D.body_get_direct_state(body_rid_rigid).get_transform().origin == Vector3(100, 100, 100))

    # On JoltPhysics, the retrieved query is Vector(0,0,0). On GodotPhysics3D the retrieved query is the correct Vector(100, 100, 100).
	print("Positioning kinematic bodies")
	var body_rid_kinematic: RID = PhysicsServer3D.body_create()
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_space(body_rid_kinematic, physics_space)
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_mode(body_rid_kinematic, PhysicsServer3D.BODY_MODE_KINEMATIC)
	PhysicsServer3D.body_set_state(body_rid_kinematic, PhysicsServer3D.BODY_STATE_TRANSFORM, transform)
	print("Queried transform is ", PhysicsServer3D.body_get_direct_state(body_rid_kinematic).get_transform().origin)
	assert (PhysicsServer3D.body_get_direct_state(body_rid_kinematic).get_transform().origin == Vector3(100, 100, 100))
```
